content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Assistant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SCTIMST Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SCTIMST Project Assistant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SCTIMST Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 11 September 2026. There is no separate application submission deadline before the walk-in.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a 3 years Diploma in Engineering / Technology in Biomedical / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 50 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the SCTIMST Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-In-Interview. A written test may be conducted as a qualifying round if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for the SCTIMST Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695012.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position. The job is on a contract basis for the duration of the project.
